name: Reaper-RunicMarkers
title: Runic Markers
author: Reaper
description:
[b]Keys changed in 0.2: place V, next symbol N, delete H (was T / Y / U). You can rebind them, or bring back T / Y / U, in Settings > Game > Runic Markers.[/b]

This is an unofficial modification. It is not made, endorsed or supported by THQ Nordic.

The Colony is a maze of caves, mines and huts that all look alike. Runic Markers lets you leave your own marks in the world: scratch a rune onto a wall or the ground wherever you look, and it stays there, softly glowing.

Some ways to use them:
[list]
[*]mark the passages you have not explored yet, so you come back to them later;
[*]mark the ground next to chests you have already opened;
[*]mark a stash, a dangerous spot or the way out of a mine.
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hold V[/b] - preview the rune where you are looking (works as a crosshair); turn the [b]mouse wheel[/b] to change the symbol
[*][b]Release V[/b] - place the rune (a quick tap places it right away)
[*][b]N[/b] - next symbol
[*][b]Hold H[/b] - the rune nearest to your crosshair glows red and a small dot marks where you aim; [b]release H[/b] to delete it
[/list]
A small indicator at the bottom of the screen shows the current symbol and its rune while you hold V and right after you change it.

[h2]Symbols[/h2]
X (visited), O (mark), Sun of Innos, Moon of Beliar, Waves of Adanos, Eye of the Sleeper, Human.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Runes stick to walls, floors and rocks; never through walls and never on characters, doors or chests.
[*]Runes are [b]saved with your savegame[/b], each save slot has its own runes.
[*]Up to 100 runes; when you place more, the oldest one disappears.
[*][b]Rune list[/b] on the Stats page: every rune with its distance, nearest first. Click one to delete it, or delete them all.
[*]The keys do nothing in menus, the inventory, dialogue or on pause. Opening the inventory or pausing while you hold V or H cancels the place / delete.
[*]Settings (Settings > Game > Runic Markers): max placing distance, glow strength (0 turns the glow off) and the three keys. Click a key box and press the new key: it works at once and is saved. A key already used by another Runic Markers key is refused.
[*]No collision, no effect on quests, NPCs or balance.
[/list]

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Subscribe, then enable Runic Markers in the game's Mod Management UI.

To uninstall, disable or unsubscribe. Your saves keep loading: the game shows "This save was made with a different modlist", choose [b]Continue anyway[/b] and the runes simply do not appear. Enable the mod again and they come back.

[h2]Known limitations (beta)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Keys are not checked against the game's own key bindings or other mods' keys: if you pick a key that is already in use, both react.
[*]If you keep holding V or H while closing the Esc menu, the hold ends there; press the key again.
[*]A rune placed across a seam between two planks or logs can look cut.
[*]On muddy or wet ground a rune can be hard to see.
[*]Runes placed after your last save are gone when you load, like any other progress.
[*]Tested under CrossOver (macOS). Windows reports are very welcome.
[/list]

[h2]License[/h2]
The mod's code and symbol art are MIT-licensed. Gothic 1 Remake and its content belong to THQ Nordic; the mod uses only the official modkit and requires a legal copy of the game.

Feedback, bugs and screenshots of your runes are welcome in the comments.
